description: Returns API key usage statistics for the current user's team: requests per key with rate limits (report summary), or requests and errors per Content API endpoint (report endpoints). Use when the user asks about API usage, request counts, failing calls, or rate limits.

end_date.description: End of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-11-08T23:59:59Z". The API defaults to now.

granularity.description: Time buckets for the summary report: "hourly" or "daily". The API defaults to "daily". Ignored for "endpoints".

report.description: "summary" = requests per API key with rate limits; "endpoints" = requests per Content API endpoint, with errors. Defaults to "summary".

start_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z". The API defaults to 7 days ago.

name: get_api_usage_stats
title: Get API usage stats
